# CyberJudah-only fixtures

These are CyberJudah's published data JSON files, retrieved from the `data` branch of
DevSecObie/cyberjudah on 2026-09-30. KJV chapters are from immutable data commit
`ac2faca11db79a8bdbd36472d83e15e2ff690bf1`, built from source commit
`20fb34b7556d48d35c7d7d9bda6a2f0dcc9dd263`.

Lexicon occurrence lists, the lexicon index, commentary lists and the Faith topic
thread are trimmed for test size. Their scripture and teaching text is unchanged.
Sorting tests vary teacher labels on a source passage; gap tests vary associations.
There is no Bible Strong content. The runtime always reads CyberJudah data or its
bundled Easton dictionary; fixtures are not bundled.
